steps.comment: Phase A of the reload round-trip. Builds a group, gives it bills, and saves. The assertions here are only that the group was real before saving — everything this phase exists for is checked by reload_roundtrip_load, in a second game load, against the file this writes. Run both with Tests/run_roundtrip.sh.

The 'before' frame: the second stove's own bills tab, empty, while it is still unlinked. Taken first on purpose — the harness's first capture in a scenario carries the HUD whatever hideUi says, and this is the one frame where that costs nothing.

Round robin is switched on before saving so the load side proves the group's mode survived too, not just its membership. A handover or a load that resets a group to in-order is a silent behaviour change nothing else would catch.

What a follower's inspect pane tells the player, as opposed to what the anchor's comp holds. These disagreed until the mode line was made to read the anchor: every non-anchor bench in a round-robin group said 'in order'. Asserted on both sides of the save, since the follower's own copy of the field is what a load would restore.
The 'after' frame: the same second stove, still owning no bills of its own, now showing the group's three. This is the field swap, which is otherwise only visible as a probe number.
